fieldNotes.research: Kenco MCS Georgia II (499,960 SF, temperature controlled, food grade) is the second building of the same Kenco Austell, GA campus as idx 8. It is most likely a building in the former The Shippers Group Austell footprint (Kenco acquired TSG January 2024). The documented TSG Austell facility at 300 Interstate West Parkway, Lithia Springs GA 30122 is 530,000 SF; a second ~500,000 SF building adjacent on the same campus would correspond to this Georgia II entry. No street address is published for it.
